business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A (P5) and the 10-K business section (P1).
business_model.claim: Harmony's sole commercial product is WAKIX (pitolisant), an oral once-daily therapy for narcolepsy. It is approved for excessive daytime sleepiness and cataplexy in patients six years and older, and it is the only FDA-approved narcolepsy treatment that is not a DEA-scheduled controlled substance.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors (P2) and business section (P1); the income statement (F2) shows only the one revenue line.

business_model.basis: Stated by the company in the Q3 release (P8) and the 10-K MD&A (P3). The coverage and penetration figures are management claims.

growth_thesis.basis: Deployment is stated in the release; the link to patient growth is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Commercial capacity expansion supports demand. Field sales, remote sales, reimbursement and outreach teams were fully deployed in Q2 2026, and sales and marketing expense rose 18% to $34.7 million in Q3. Growth continuing requires these teams to keep converting into patient additions, since the cost is already in the run rate.
quotes: Executed expansion of field sales, remote sales, field reimbursement and patient outreach teams with all roles hired, trained and fully deployed in Q2
primarily driven by the expansion of our field-based teams

growth_thesis.basis: Approval is stated in the 10-K and carried through to the Q3 10-Q.
growth_thesis.claim: Label breadth supports the WAKIX franchise. The FDA approved pediatric cataplexy in February 2026, so WAKIX is now approved for EDS and cataplexy in patients six years and older with narcolepsy. The condition is that prescribers adopt the pediatric labels.
quotes: In February 2026, the FDA approved WAKIX for the treatment of cataplexy in pediatric patients six years and older with narcolepsy.

growth_thesis.basis: Guidance and nine-month results are stated; whether the guidance is met is not known.
growth_thesis.claim: Management guides 2026 WAKIX net revenue to $1.0 billion to $1.04 billion and reiterated it. Nine-month net product revenue was $745,584 (table in thousands) against $624,677. Delivery needs Q4 demand to hold.
quotes: Reiterated full year guidance of $1.0 billion to $1.04 billion.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated by management; the legal outcomes are not known.
growth_thesis.claim: Exclusivity is a condition for growth to last. Management expresses confidence in WAKIX exclusivity to March 2030 after settling with 6 of 7 ANDA filers. The AET ANDA ruling is expected around February 2027, and a preliminary injunction hearing in the amorphous-patent case is set for January 26, 2027. Pediatric exclusivity depends on completing the TEMPO study.
quotes: ruling is expected around the time of the 30-month stay (February 2027)
Together with settlements with 6 of the 7 ANDA filers, these actions reinforce Harmony's confidence in WAKIX exclusivity to March 2030 (inclusive of 6 months of pediatric exclusivity)

growth_thesis.basis: Timelines are stated by the company; outcomes are not known.
growth_thesis.claim: Next-generation pitolisant formulations are the franchise-extension driver. The Pitolisant GR NDA was accepted by the FDA with a PDUFA date of April 1, 2027. Pitolisant HD has Phase 3 topline data expected in 2027 and a target PDUFA date in 2028. These need FDA approval and positive Phase 3 data.
quotes: NDA accepted by the FDA with PDUFA date of April 1, 2027
Topline data expected in 2027 and anticipated PDUFA date in 2028

growth_thesis.basis: Timelines are stated by management; commercial potential is not shown.
growth_thesis.claim: BP-205, an orexin-2 agonist, is the long-dated pipeline driver. Phase 1b data are due in Q1 2027 and Phase 2 studies in multiple CNS indications are expected to start by mid-2027. This depends on the Phase 1b results.
quotes: Expect to initiate Phase 2 studies to evaluate multiple CNS indications by mid-2027

growth_thesis.basis: Timelines are stated by the company; the outcome is not known.
growth_thesis.claim: EPX-100 in rare epilepsy is a further pipeline driver. It is in two Phase 3 registrational trials, with topline data expected in 2027 and a target PDUFA date in 2028. This needs positive Phase 3 results.
quotes: We expect topline data in 2027 and anticipate a target PDUFA date in 2028.

growth_thesis.basis: Balances and the liquidity view are stated in the 10-Q; any acquisition is not shown.
growth_thesis.claim: Financial capacity funds growth from internal resources. Cash, cash equivalents and investments were $1,052.0 million against outstanding debt of $150.0 million at September 30, 2026. Management lists strategic business development, including assets that add near-term revenue, as a use of the balance sheet. This depends on continued cash generation and on finding deals.
quotes: As of September 30, 2026, we had cash, cash equivalents, and investments of $1,052.0 million, outstanding debt of $150.0 million and retained earnings of $317.0 million.
Supported by a strong balance sheet and clear conviction to execute on strategic business development opportunities

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the income statement; the drivers of cost of product sold are not explained in the packet.
growth_thesis.claim: Revenue growth has not yet carried through to Q3 operating profit. Q3 cost of product sold rose to $80,686 (table in thousands) from $59,650, and operating income fell to $54,197 from $65,487. R&D included a $25.0 million MSN milestone charge. Earnings growth requires cost growth and milestone charges to stay below revenue growth.
quotes: primarily driven by a $25.0 million charge related to a milestone achieved for the MSN license agreement

material_events.basis: stated in the 8-K Item 5.02 and repeated in the Q3 earnings release
material_events.claim: The company announced a CEO succession. Dr. Dayno will retire as President and CEO and leave the board at year-end, and COO Peter Anastasiou will succeed him on the next day.
quotes: will be retiring as the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release
material_events.claim: US patent approval for the licensed MSN patents triggered a $25.0 million milestone payment, which the company expects to pay in the fourth quarter of 2026.
quotes: triggered a $25.0 million milestone payment, which we expect to be paid in the fourth quarter of 2026.

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-Q and the earnings release
material_events.claim: The FDA accepted the Pitolisant GR NDA for full review and a target PDUFA date has been set.
quotes: NDA accepted by the FDA with PDUFA date of April 1, 2027

material_events.claim: In the pitolisant ANDA patent litigation against AET, the judge scheduled a preliminary injunction hearing. A ruling in the bench-trial case is expected near the end of the 30-month stay.
quotes: the judge scheduled a preliminary injunction hearing on January 26, 2027

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-K and consistent with the 10-Q description of the label
material_events.claim: The FDA approved WAKIX for cataplexy in pediatric patients with narcolepsy, extending the label.
quotes: In February 2026, the FDA approved WAKIX for the treatment of cataplexy in pediatric patients six years and older with narcolepsy.

material_events.claim: The Phase 3 RECONNECT trial of ZYN002 failed its primary endpoint, and the company is phasing out the ZYN002 Fragile X program.
quotes: The RECONNECT study did not meet the primary endpoint of improvement in social avoidance primarily due to a higher-than-expected placebo response rate.

risks.basis: Litigation timing is stated in the 8-K earnings release. The revenue-concentration language is stated in the 10-K. The impact on revenue is inferred.
risks.claim: WAKIX exclusivity depends on pending generic (ANDA) patent litigation. A ruling in the AET bench trial is expected around the 30-month stay expiry in February 2027. A loss would expose the product on which the company says it depends for substantially all revenue.
quotes: ruling is expected around the time of the 30-month stay (February 2027)

Because we expect the sales of WAKIX to generate substantially all of our revenue for the foreseeable future, the failure of WAKIX to find market acceptance would substantially harm our business and could require us to seek additional financing.

risks.basis: Guidance is stated in the cited 8-K release and revenue in the 10-Q income statement. The risk of a miss is inferred, not stated.
risks.claim: Full-year WAKIX revenue guidance of $1.0 billion to $1.04 billion was reiterated, so a shortfall against it is a risk. Nine-month net product revenue was 745,584 (table in thousands).
quotes: Reiterated full year guidance of $1.0 billion to $1.04 billion.

risks.basis: Figures are stated in the 10-Q statements and the 8-K release. The margin-pressure reading is inferred.
risks.claim: Q3 profitability fell even as revenue rose. Operating income was 54,197 (table in thousands) against 65,487 a year earlier. Cost of product sold rose to 80,686 from 59,650. R&D rose, helped by a $25.0 million license milestone charge.
quotes: this was primarily driven by a $25.0 million charge related to a milestone achieved for the MSN license agreement

risks.basis: Dates and past setbacks are stated in the filings. The probability of failure is not given and any inference is the analyst's.
risks.claim: Pipeline and regulatory events are concentrated in 2027. The Pitolisant GR PDUFA date is April 1, 2027, and Pitolisant HD, EPX-100 and TEMPO data are due in 2027. The company has had earlier setbacks: ZYN002 missed its primary endpoint and the IH sNDA drew a refusal-to-file letter.
quotes: In June 2026, we submitted an NDA for Pitolisant GR to the FDA, which was subsequently accepted for full review with a target PDUFA date of April 1, 2027.
The RECONNECT study did not meet the primary endpoint of improvement in social avoidance primarily due to a higher-than-expected placebo response rate.

risks.basis: Stated as a risk factor in the 10-K and reaffirmed in the 10-Q. Likelihood is not stated.
risks.claim: The company relies on Bioprojet license agreements for the core pitolisant intellectual property. Termination or loss of those rights would materially harm the business.
quotes: If, for any reason, our license and commercialization agreements with Bioprojet are terminated or we otherwise lose those rights, it would materially adversely affect our business.

risks.basis: The transition is stated in the 8-K. The execution risk is inferred.
risks.claim: The CEO changes on January 1, 2027, with the current CEO retiring and the COO succeeding him. This adds execution risk while the patent rulings and the GR PDUFA date approach.
quotes: This planned leadership transition does not change Harmony's previously communicated strategic priorities or the expected timing of key commercial and pipeline milestones.

risks.basis: Cash and debt are stated in the 10-Q. The risk language is boilerplate, and the evidence points against near-term stress.
risks.claim: A liquidity shortfall is not supported as a near-term risk. The company has $1,052.0 million of cash and investments against $150.0 million of debt. It says capital use could come sooner than expected if its assumptions prove wrong.
quotes: We have based our liquidity and cash flow projections on assumptions that may prove to be incorrect, and we could use our capital resources sooner than we expect.

quotes: ruling is expected around the time of the 30-month stay (February 2027)

quotes: Reiterated full year guidance of $1.0 billion to $1.04 billion.

quotes: The increase in cost of product sales and cost of sales as a percentage of net revenue was due to triggering a higher royalty tier under the 2017 LCA earlier in 2025 compared to 2024.

quotes: triggered a $25.0 million milestone payment, which we expect to be paid in the fourth quarter of 2026.

completion of TEMPO study fulfills the second and last requirement agreed with FDA for WAKIX pediatric exclusivity
